reason: All 29 registered tools implement Google Tag Manager v2 account, container, workspace, entity, built-in-variable, and release operations; no stubs found.
exposure: All eight registration groups are enabled unconditionally by src/index.ts; all 29 tools are exposed by default. Service-account credentials are required only when handlers execute.
limitations: Catalog obtained offline from an isolated dependency installation and compiled source with a minimal subprocess environment; only initialize and tools/list were invoked. Google Tag Manager handler behavior was inspected statically and not exercised against the remote API.

tools.name: gtm_create_trigger
tools.description:
Create a new trigger in a workspace.

Common trigger types:
- PAGEVIEW: Fires on page view
- CLICK: Fires on click events
- LINK_CLICK: Fires on link clicks
- FORM_SUBMISSION: Fires on form submit
- CUSTOM_EVENT: Fires on custom dataLayer events
- DOM_READY: Fires when DOM is ready
- WINDOW_LOADED: Fires when window loads
- ELEMENT_VISIBILITY: Fires when element becomes visible

parameter.description: Condition operands, typically arg0 (a variable reference like '{{_event}}') and arg1 (the value to compare)

custom_event_filter.description: For CUSTOM_EVENT triggers, the event filter conditions

filter.description: General filter conditions for the trigger

tools.behavior: Calls Google Tag Manager v2 accounts.containers.workspaces.triggers.create.

tools.description: Update an existing trigger in a workspace. Only the provided fields are changed; provided filter arrays replace the existing ones wholesale.

trigger_id.description: The GTM trigger ID to update

parameter.description: Condition operands, typically arg0 (a variable reference like '{{_event}}') and arg1 (the value to compare)

custom_event_filter.description: New custom event filter conditions (replaces existing)

tools.behavior: Calls Google Tag Manager v2 accounts.containers.workspaces.triggers.get, then accounts.containers.workspaces.triggers.update. Reads the existing entity, merges provided fields, and updates using its fingerprint.
